newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FACTFILE ON NEW COVENTRY MANAGER STRACHAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FACTFILE ON NEW COVENTRY MANAGER STRACHAN.

text.p: Following is factfile on Gordon
Strachan, who on Tuesday replaced Ron Atkinson as manager of
English premier league side Coventry City.
1957: Born February 9, Edinburgh.
1974: Signed for Dundee.
1974-77: Scored 13 goals in 60 league games.
1977: Joined Aberdeen for 50,000 pounds ($80,000).
1977-84: Netted 55 goals in 187 league games. In 1980 he won
Scottish Championship medal and first of 50 Scotland caps
against Northern Ireland. He won three successive Scottish Cup
winners' medals from 1982, in 1983 he also won a European Cup
Winners' Cup medal and in 1984 lifted the Scottish Championship.
1984: Signed by English club Manchester United manager Ron
Atkinson for 500,000 pounds ($800,000).
1984-89: Scored 33 goals in 160 league games and in 1985 won
an F.A. Cup medal.
1989: Joined second division Leeds in March for 300,000
1989-94: In 1990 he captained the club to the second
division title. Two years later he led Howard Wilkinson's side
to a first League championship in 18 years.
1995: Announced retirement from premier league football in
January and two months later joined Atkinson at Coventry as
assistant.
1996: Appointed Coventry manager when Atkinson stepped down.
